_readme: Artwork registry for the wheel UI. Every entry is optional: anything
missing gets a generated placeholder that says 'artwork pending'.
Drop the file on R2 (or in assets/) and add its URL here -- no code
changes. Keys:
tabs   : section id (games, apps, emulation, Testing, form, report,
executor, links, tutorials, movies, credits, redproxy) -> logo
image URL. Transparent PNG, about 1200x400, shown ~50vw wide.
games  : game key (the Games/Testing/Apps folder name exactly, or the
emulator entry's icon slug) -> logo image URL. Transparent PNG,
about 900x400. When absent the 256px icon from assets/icons/
is used, and when that is absent too, a placeholder.
sfx    : tick | select | back | hover -> audio file URL, replacing the
synthesized sound of the same name.
music  : URL of the looping background theme. When set, it plays for
anyone with the Music switch on (default on). Leave empty
until the track exists.
layerBase : where theme layer folders live.
layerBaseLocal : used instead when the page is on localhost /
127.0.0.1 -- copy the theme folders into assets/themes/
of the checkout (git-ignored) to test before syncing.
